address: 8 Lane 194, Xinhe Street, South District, Taichung, Taiwan
bio: Ji Zai Ten is Taichung’s first vegan ramen restaurant. Its house-made noodles are prepared without eggs yet remain satisfyingly chewy, paired with rich broths and well-developed sauces. The chef transforms seasonal fruits and vegetables into refined, flavour-driven dishes that blend Japanese inspiration with a subtle Taiwanese influence. Go for the set menu featuring vegan patties over rice alongside ramen for a more complete experience.
